title: A2UI Basic Catalog
description: Unified catalog of basic A2UI components and functions.
instructions:
For layout, use the Row and Column components to organize other components.

## Catalog Guidelines

1. String Concatenation & Formatting: A2UI does not support binary operators like '+' or formatting symbols. To concatenate strings or dynamically inject data bindings into text, you must use the catalog function `formatString(value)` where the value string contains placeholders formatted as `${expression}`:
   formatString("Hello ${/user/name}")

2. Strict Hierarchy: You must strictly adhere to the requested component nesting and hierarchy. If the prompt specifies that a component is 'inside' or 'contained in' another component, you MUST place it as a child of that specific component, not as a sibling or in a different container.

3. Validation Checks: When components support validation checks, specify any custom error messages directly as the 'message' inside the check. Do NOT create separate text-display components to display validation errors.

Weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text content to display. While simple Markdown formatting is supported (i.e. without HTML, images, or links), utilizing dedicated UI components is generally preferred for a richer and more structured presentation.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: A hint for the base text style.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the image to display.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Accessibility text for the image.

parameters.name: fit
parameters.description: Specifies how the image should be resized to fit its container. This corresponds to the CSS 'object-fit' property.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: A hint for the image size and style.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the icon to display.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the video to display.

parameters.name: posterUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the poster image to display before the video plays.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the audio to be played.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description of the audio, such as a title or summary.

components.name: Row
components.description: A layout component that arranges its children horizontally. To create a grid layout, nest Columns within this Row.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

parameters.name: justify
parameters.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges, or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

parameters.name: align
parameters.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (vertically). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property, but uses camelCase values (e.g., 'start').

components.name: Column
components.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

parameters.name: justify
parameters.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges (e.g. header at top, footer at bottom), or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

parameters.name: align
parameters.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The direction in which the list items are laid out.

parameters.name: align
parameters.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis.

parameters.name: child
parameters.description: The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card. To display multiple elements, you MUST wrap them in a layout component (like Column or Row) and pass that container's ID here. Do NOT pass multiple IDs or a non-existent ID.

parameters.name: tabs
parameters.description: An array of objects, where each object defines a tab with a title and a child component.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The ID of the child component.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The ID of the component that opens the modal when interacted with (e.g., a button).

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The ID of the component to be displayed inside the modal.

parameters.name: axis
parameters.description: The orientation of the divider.

parameters.name: child
parameters.description: The ID of the child component. Use a 'Text' component for a labeled button. Only use an 'Icon' if the requirements explicitly ask for an icon-only button.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: A hint for the button style. If omitted, a default button style is used. 'primary' indicates this is the main call-to-action button. 'borderless' means the button has no visual border or background, making its child content appear like a clickable link.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The text label for the input field.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value of the text field.

parameters.name: placeholder
parameters.description: The placeholder text for the input field.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: The type of input field to display.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The text to display next to the checkbox.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked).

components.name: ChoicePicker
components.description: A component that allows selecting one or more options from a list.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The label for the group of options.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: A hint for how the choice picker should be displayed and behave.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The list of available options to choose from.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The text to display for this option.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The stable value associated with this option.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The list of currently selected values. This should be bound to a string array in the data model.

parameters.name: displayStyle
parameters.description: The display style of the component.

parameters.name: filterable
parameters.description: If true, displays a search input to filter the options.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The label for the slider.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: The minimum value of the slider.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: The maximum value of the slider.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The current value of the slider.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: The number of discrete divisions in the slider range. If specified, the slider will snap to discrete values.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. If not yet set, initialize with an empty string.

parameters.name: enableDate
parameters.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

parameters.name: enableTime
parameters.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: The minimum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: The maximum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The text label for the input field.

functions.name: required
functions.description: Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to check.

functions.name: regex
functions.description: Checks that the value matches a regular expression string.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: The regular expression to search for in the value. Uses the A2UI regex dialect: a portable subset of ECMAScript pattern syntax in Unicode mode with no flags.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: The minimum allowed length.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: The maximum allowed length.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: The minimum allowed value.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: The maximum allowed value.

functions.name: email
functions.description: Checks that the value is a valid email address.

functions.name: formatString
functions.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string.

functions.name: formatNumber
functions.description: Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The number to format.

parameters.name: decimals
parameters.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

parameters.name: grouping
parameters.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

functions.name: formatCurrency
functions.description: Formats a number as a currency string.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The monetary amount.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

parameters.name: decimals
parameters.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

parameters.name: grouping
parameters.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

functions.name: formatDate
functions.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The date to format.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

functions.name: pluralize
functions.description: Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The numeric value used to determine the plural category.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: String for the 'zero' category (e.g., 0 items).

parameters.name: one
parameters.description: String for the 'one' category (e.g., 1 item).

parameters.name: two
parameters.description: String for the 'two' category (used in Arabic, Welsh, etc.).

parameters.name: few
parameters.description: String for the 'few' category (e.g., small groups in Slavic languages).

parameters.name: many
parameters.description: String for the 'many' category (e.g., large groups in various languages).

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The default/fallback string (used for general plural cases).

functions.name: openUrl
functions.description: Opens the specified URL in a browser or handler (requires user activation). This function has no return value.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to open.

functions.name: and
functions.description: Performs a logical AND operation on a list of boolean values.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

functions.name: or
functions.description: Performs a logical OR operation on a list of boolean values.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

functions.name: not
functions.description: Performs a logical NOT operation on a boolean value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The boolean value to negate.
